meta.title: The Blackglass Maze
meta.premise: A buried observatory has folded its halls into a blackglass maze, and a stolen star-map waits somewhere below.

moon-gate.name: The Moon Gate
moon-gate.brief: A round chamber beneath a cracked silver arch.
moon-gate.description: Dust lies in a perfect ring around the arch, except for fresh boot prints leading into the dark.

echo-hall.name: The Echo Hall
echo-hall.brief: A long gallery where every footstep returns twice.
echo-hall.description: Blackglass panels reflect the hall at impossible angles; a lantern burns at the far end.

star-shrine.name: The Star Shrine
star-shrine.brief: A collapsed chapel beneath a ceiling of painted constellations.
star-shrine.description: The painted stars have been scratched out one by one, leaving only a cold white comet.

glass-vault.name: The Glass Vault
glass-vault.brief: A sealed vault whose walls show a sky with no sun.
glass-vault.description: The lock is a circle of black glass, and something inside taps in a patient rhythm.

glass-warden.name: the glass warden
glass-warden.brief: A hollow sentinel wrapped in mirrored plates.

star-map.name: the stolen star-map
star-map.brief: A thin sheet of hammered silver showing a road through the underworld.

pry-bar.name: a pry bar
pry-bar.brief: A short iron bar with a flattened hook.

find-star-map.title: The stolen star-map
find-star-map.note: Find the silver map before the maze shifts again.
